summary: Create, discover, evaluate, compare, and maintain Agent Skills and agent workflows.

skills.choose_when: The task is to create, consolidate, test, or revise an Agent Skill or SKILL.md.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use merely to find or install an existing skill.
skills.name: create-agent-skill

skills.choose_when: The task is to find, compare, audit, or install an existing Agent Skill.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use when the requested outcome is authoring a new skill.
skills.name: discover-agent-skills

skills.choose_when: The task evaluates an agent, skill, workflow, or tool-using system with explicit tasks, graders, traces, or failure analysis.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary product or model evaluation without an agent or workflow behavior contract.
triggers: compare two versions of this agent
skills.name: evaluate-agent
